text:
Alex: quick sync — where are we on kernel work + continuous-batching + KV prefetch for this sprint? need owners, blockers, and any infra gating before EOD. :eyes:

Maria: working on microkernel changes, PR in draft (WIP). main blocker is test flakiness on seq-len > 1024. filing flakes ticket now.

Raj: KV prefetch branch ready, running perf harness. tail latency drops ~6% on p99 for small batch workloads. will post benchmark run.

Sam: continuous batching changes landed last night. saw a regressed cold-start by ~10% — investigating.

Tasha: can we pin owners for canary? infra needs a list to reserve capacity. proposed owners:
- kernel: Maria
- kv-prefetch: Raj
- batching: Sam
- rollout: Jen

Jen: confirmed — I'll coordinate infra capacity and rollout window with eng-infra and eng-sre. Need exact canary command and expected traffic shape.

Raj: benchmark excerpt:
```
./bench --model small --seq 512 --qps 200 --runs 5
p50: 12.3ms p95: 45.1ms p99: 87.4ms
baseline p99: 95.0ms -> after prefetch p99: 87.4ms  (8% improvement)
```

Alex: nice. Sam, what's causing the cold-start regression? can we mitigate with warmup hook or staggered start?

Sam: seems like cache warming order changed; KV warmup now delayed by batching initialization. Simple fix: call kv.warmup() before batch scheduler init — testing in a hotfix branch.

CI Bot: CI results for branch raj/kv-prefetch: 14/15 tests passed (1 flaky), perf checks OK.

OpsBot: Reminder — capacity request form must be filled 24h before canary. Jen, can you submit by 15:00 UTC?

Jen: will submit by 14:30. target canary window tomorrow 09:00-12:00 PT. pinging eng-infra and eng-sre.

Maria: opened flakes ticket -> FLK-238. tagging @Sam for repro steps.

Sam: added repro and quick fix in sam/coldstart-warmup; small unit test added.

Alex: action items:
- Maria: finish PR and address FLK-238 (owner)
- Raj: post full perf run and link artifacts (owner)
- Sam: hotfix PR for warmup ordering (owner)
- Jen: submit capacity request + coordinate canary window (owner)
- Alex: I'll schedule a 15-min post-canary review

Alex: if no major blockers, proceed — otherwise call it out here. :rocket:
